value.linkage: alpha-(1->4) glycosidic, the homogalacturonan backbone. One residue is one alpha-D-galactopyranuronate unit. The two attachment points in the SMILES are, in written order, the O4 oxygen (bonded to the preceding residue's anomeric C1) and the anomeric C1 itself (bonded to the following residue's O4). Each residue therefore owns exactly ONE bridging oxygen, its own O4, so the bridging oxygen is counted once per residue and never twice. That accounting is what makes the residue C6H7O6 rather than C6H7O7.
value.end_groups: None are counted. ChEBI writes the whole chain as (C6H7O6)n.H2O (CHEBI:140523): n residues plus one water, the water being the H on the non-reducing end's O4 and the OH on the reducing end's anomeric C1. yeast-GEM writes the species as ONE residue, C6H7O6, with no terminal water, which is the per-repeat-unit convention the repeat-unit surrogate route requires. The GEM's own stoichiometry confirms it: r_0365 consumes one pectin and one water and yields one D-galacturonate, which is exactly residue + H2O -> monomer at n = 1.
value.convention_note: The GEM species s_1309 pectin is ONE alpha-1,4-linked D-galacturonate residue of homogalacturonan at degree of methyl esterification 0, with the C6 carboxyl deprotonated, so the residue carries charge -1. This is not invented here: ChEBI tabulates exactly this entity as CHEBI:140523 [(1->4)-alpha-D-galacturonosyl](n), formula (C6H7O6)n.H2O, charge -1, 'Major microspecies at pH 7.3', and Rhea uses it as the polymer participant in RHEA:13573. The GEM's elemental formula C6H7O6 is therefore CORRECT as shipped and needs no change; only the charge is wrong. C6H7O6 at charge 0 is not a neutral closed-shell molecule, as the row noted. The neutral residue is C6H8O6 (ChEBI:15446, (C6H8O6)n.H2O, charge 0; also the (C6H8O6)n term of ChEBI:62969 polygalacturonic acid), and the anion obtained by removing the carboxylic proton is C6H7O6 at charge -1. yeast-GEM took the deprotonated composition and left the charge field at 0. Degree of methyl esterification is 0 and not free to choose: the methyl-esterified residue is a different tabulated entity, CHEBI:140522 [(1->4)-alpha-D-galacturonosyl methyl ester](n), (C7H10O6)n.H2O at charge 0, and any nonzero esterification would break the elemental balance of r_0365 by CH2 per esterified residue. Acetylation is likewise 0, for the same reason. Do NOT take the structure MetaNetX offers for the GEM's own annotation: MNXM107600 is deprecated and redirects to MNXM726528 = chebi:15446 rendered as the free monomer C6H10O7 at charge 0, which would make r_0365 unbalanced by one water. Do NOT take CHEBI:60190 homogalacturonan either: its repeat is (C17H22O15)n, a methyl-esterified and acetylated dimer, and its SMILES carries the esters explicitly. Do NOT take KEGG C00714, whose repeat is (C26H36O24)n, four residues at degree of methyl esterification 0.5.

Expected: the repeat unit carries two attachment points and is therefore a PLACEHOLDER_STRUCTURE, which component contribution cannot price. In the same run the monomer alpha-D-galacturonate (CHEBI:58658) decomposed into 8 groups, so the residue's energy must come from the repeat-unit surrogate route off the priced monomer, never from feeding this SMILES to the structure route.

notes:
WHICH KIND THIS ROW IS. Both, and the split is clean. r_0365 balances ELEMENTALLY as shipped (C6H7O6 + H2O = C6H9O7, no element key in cobra's check_mass_balance) and fails ONLY on charge, by exactly -1. So the elemental formula needs no correction and the row is not a formula correction in the elemental sense; it is a CHARGE correction (fbc:charge 0 -> -1 on s_1309) plus a polymer convention. kind is set to polymer_convention because the convention is what unblocks pricing, and the charge fix is one field inside it, carried as value.proposed_charge. A code agent should apply both: the charge, and the repeat-unit reading of the species.

WHY PECTIN DID NOT TAKE THE REPEAT-UNIT SURROGATE ROUTE. It was a candidate and it failed one precondition. thermo_polymer_repeat_unit.py refuses a species unless every non-boundary reaction carrying it is mass balanced, because a residue energy computed against per-chain stoichiometry would be wrong by the chain length. r_0365 fails that check on charge, so the existing thermo_polymer_repeat_unit.json records s_1309 with outcome stoichiometry_not_per_repeat_unit and detail 'mass balance fails on r_0365; a residue energy would be wrong by the chain length'. The refusal was correct behavior and the diagnosis it printed was the only part that was misleading: the stoichiometry IS per repeat unit, and the imbalance is a charge annotation bug, not a chain-length bug. The script's monomer finder would otherwise have succeeded on its own, since r_0365 has the exact shape it looks for (species + n H2O -> n monomer with n = 1) and D-galacturonate s_0560 is priced. Once fbc:charge on s_1309 is -1, the precondition passes and the route claims the species with no change to the script.

WHAT THE SURROGATE WOULD THEN PRODUCE. Computed here, not produced by a pipeline run, so treat it as a forecast rather than a result: R = G'(D-galacturonate) - G'(H2O) + 6.0505 = -820.1443 + 178.4697 + 6.0505 = -635.62 kJ/mol at compartment e conditions, with sigma = sqrt(1.3286^2 + 0.7590^2 + 3.4063^2) = 3.73 kJ/mol. The independent cross-check off the cached C18H23O19 trianion gives -639.95 kJ/mol, a 4.33 kJ/mol difference, within that sigma. Both numbers are component-contribution values, so the agreement tests the CONVENTION (is C6H7O6 one residue? is a chain n residues plus one water?) and says nothing about the accuracy of either energy. sigma_kj_per_mol is left null in this record because the record admits a convention, not an energy; the surrogate route computes and labels its own sigma.

ADMISSION. tabulated, and the word refers to the STRUCTURE and CONVENTION, not to an energy. CHEBI:140523 tabulates the repeat unit as (C6H7O6)n.H2O at charge -1, Rhea uses that same entity in RHEA:13573, and CHEBI:15446 and CHEBI:140522 pin down the neutral and the methyl-esterified alternatives so the choice is forced rather than picked. NO measured and NO tabulated formation energy for pectin, polygalacturonic acid or the galacturonate residue was found anywhere: Rhea curates no EC 3.2.1.15 reaction, the NIST TECRDB search returned no apparent equilibrium constant for a (1->4)-alpha-D-galacturonide hydrolysis, and no combustion or formation table covers the polymer. The two literature leads carried into this row (PMC5153499 and PubMed 20668400) are activation and denaturation parameters and were rejected. That negative is the reason the energy has to come from the surrogate.

WHAT A HUMAN STILL NEEDS TO DO. (1) Decide whether to change fbc:charge on s_1309 in a local copy of yeast-GEM or to carry the correction as a pipeline-side override, and if it is carried locally, report it upstream to yeast-GEM: the shipped model has a charge-unbalanced r_0365 and the fix is one attribute. (2) Confirm the intent to re-annotate s_1309 from ChEBI:17309 (a structureless heteropolysaccharide class) to ChEBI:140523, and from the deprecated MNXM107600 to nothing rather than to MNXM726528, since MetaNetX's replacement is the free monomer and would silently unbalance r_0365 by one water. (3) Confirm that degree of methyl esterification 0 is the intended reading of this GEM species. It is forced by the elemental balance of r_0365 as the model is written, but real pectin is partially esterified, so the model is describing pectate rather than pectin and the species name is a misnomer; that is a modeling judgment, not a curation one. (4) Decide whether the repeat-unit SMILES recorded here is stored at all. It carries attachment points and is proven here not to decompose, so it must never reach the structure route; its only use is documentation of what the residue is. (5) Sanity-check the alpha anomeric configuration in the recorded SMILES against a drawn structure. It was obtained by substituting attachment points into CHEBI:140523's own SMILES without touching any stereo descriptor, and the capped form reproduces CHEBI:58658 canonically, but no independent depiction was inspected. | 2026-09-11 integration: recorded as a CHARGE-only correction (formula C6H7O6 unchanged, charge 0 -> -1). The repeat unit carries two attachment points and will never decompose, so the price has to come from the repeat-unit surrogate off the priced monomer, not from the structure route.
